# Leyoxa

> Leyoxa provides dental market intelligence for acquisition and expansion.
> The product path is: metro screening → submarket opportunity → competitor and practice mapping → target-specific diligence.

Leyoxa LLC is a Texas company with a registered office in Austin. Founder Sepehr Aflatounian is based in Toronto. The primary focus is dental growth in the United States, followed by Canada.

## What Leyoxa helps buyers decide

- Which metro deserves deeper evaluation.
- Which submarkets show the strongest combination of demand, supply, access, economics, and growth signals.
- Which practices, competitors, referral patterns, and local conditions shape the opportunity.
- What must be verified inside a specific acquisition target before and after close.

Leyoxa is designed for dental-group founders, DSO corporate-development teams, investors, operators, and integration leaders evaluating an expansion or acquisition decision.

## Intelligence path

1. [Metro screening](https://leyoxa.com/whats-live.html): compare markets using dated, source-linked public evidence and explicit limitations.
2. Submarket opportunity: narrow the metro into practical trade areas and test the growth thesis against local demand, supply, access, and economics.
3. Competitor and practice mapping: organize the practice landscape, ownership signals, specialties, locations, and relevant market context.
4. [Target-specific diligence](https://leyoxa.com/page-services.html): move from public intelligence into approved private evidence, record continuity, migration verification, documentation gaps, and buyer sign-off.

## Current public market intelligence

- [San Antonio dental market](https://leyoxa.com/san-antonio-dental-market.html): Bexar County establishment structure and national consolidation context, with source limitations stated.
- [Toronto dental market](https://leyoxa.com/toronto-dental-market.html): Ontario establishment structure, Toronto demand context, and the RCDSO practice-model process.
- Public market reports support screening and hypothesis formation. They are not valuations, forecasts, legal opinions, or recommendations to acquire a practice.

## Target diligence and Care Ledger

- [Target diligence](https://leyoxa.com/page-services.html): readiness sample, permitted read-only snapshot, selected cross-source reconciliation, methodology, limitations, and accountable handoff.
- [Care Ledger](https://leyoxa.com/care-ledger.html): a target-diligence artifact containing source-linked record states organized by location, PMS, owner, age, and next action.
- [Periodontal example](https://leyoxa.com/perio.html): one record category showing longitudinal reconciliation without a generated diagnosis.
- Buyer: dental-group corporate development, diligence, and integration leaders with an identified target or dated transaction.
- Commercial model: fixed engagement priced by market or target scope, location count, PMS mix, historical depth, access path, and delivery window.

## Diligence readiness gates

- Prove a permitted read path for every in-scope PMS.
- Sample chart-note quality and source completeness before accepting a full record scope.
- State unavailable fields and unsupported history explicitly.
- Agree reporting, responsibility, retention, and handoff protocols before production access.

Open Dental, Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Curve, and other PMS names describe possible acquisition environments. They are not claims of currently available connectors. Direct database, approved export, vendor, or third-party access may be required.

## Clinical and system boundary

- Leyoxa reports record states, not untreated disease or clinical findings.
- Leyoxa does not assert diagnoses or recommend treatment.
- Target-diligence review is read-only and does not write charts, plans, diagnoses, appointments, or communications to a PMS.
- Each acquired practice and its dentists retain clinical responsibility.
- Plan value is ledger context, not revenue; any acceptance scenario is illustrative and not guaranteed.

## Product direction after close

- [Platform direction](https://leyoxa.com/workspace.html): connect approved sources across mixed PMS and business systems, create role-specific workspaces with plain-language AI, and activate bounded agents.
- [Intelligence direction](https://leyoxa.com/intelligence.html): rank locations and anomalies by estimated opportunity, urgency, confidence, and effort; carry each recommendation through action and outcome verification.
- Connected sources remain authoritative and retain provenance.
- Agent actions progress from reading and preparation to approval-gated communication or system action; clinical authority remains with qualified people.
- The broader operating layer is product direction, not the current public market-intelligence deliverable.

## Proof status

Public product interfaces use fictional data and describe product direction, not customer outcomes. Market reports cite dated public evidence. Target diligence requires approved data access, a defined scope, and explicit responsibility boundaries.

## Shipped work

- [Praxis AI](https://leyoxa.com/case-praxis.html): flagship venture-studio collaboration with an independent dental AI company; its products and public claims remain Praxis's own.
- [SmileLink](https://leyoxa.com/case-smilelink.html): shipped patient access, scheduling, secure communication, and clinic workflow software.
- [Emergclinic](https://leyoxa.com/case-emergclinic.html): completed Toronto emergency-dental routing pilot; no longer live.
- [Selected work](https://leyoxa.com/case-studies.html): ownership, contribution, and current status are stated per case.
